label: GO step choosing a1, early in the episode, soon after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.7% of mass; never at D1, a trace at D2 after S2). It needs the agent to pick a1 (model_act==1 holds 91% of the mass, lift 5.6x; mass grows with the a1 policy logit). It dies out over the episode: rate is 0.13 in trials 0-9 and zero after trial ~75. Within that, it is strongest on the GO right after an unrewarded trial and fades over a run of rewarded a1 trials (e.g. 1.00, 0.49, 0.30, 0.16). GO + a1 alone gives dev F1 0.42 with mass recall 0.91. Adding ep_trial<50 gives F1 0.62. Also requiring an unrewarded outcome in the last 2 trials gives precision 0.80, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.76. Uses only observed variables plus the agent s own choice. Does not fire on a2 choices, on rewarded inputs at D1, or late in the episode. The ep_trial dependence likely reflects slow drift of the hidden state rather than a clean concept, so the explanation is partial.
